bio.jane/contract.question: What major and minor allele copy number does each segment carry?

description: Read an Affymetrix array result's own allele-specific copy number: for each segment the major and minor allele counts (1+1, 2+0, 0+0), what they mean (balanced, allelic imbalance, loss of heterozygosity placed against the sample's own ploidy, homozygous deletion), and ASCAT's whole-genome summary over them (LOH fraction, homozygous deletions, modal allele state, whole-genome doubling, genomic instability). OncoScan results state a split when the aberrant-cell fraction was determined; the tool says why when a file states none.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

estimated_only.description: report only the segments the producer split. Default false: an unestimated segment is listed as such, which is a different answer from its absence.

file.description: which copy-number file in this project, by name. Unset, it is the project's only one, and it refuses rather than guessing when there are several.

name: copy_number_allele_split

metrics.description: ASCAT 3.2.0's ascat.metrics() profile columns over the estimated segments, unrounded: n_segs, segs_size, size_odd_segments, size_intermediate_segments, homdel_segs, homdel_largest, homdel_size, homdel_fraction, LOH (autosomal fraction), mode_minA, mode_majA, WGD (0, 1, '1+' or null) and GI (null when WGD is). Null when nothing is estimated

provenance.description: which file answered, the data set the split was read from, how many segments it holds and how many are estimated, and the producer's own fit: ploidy and aberrant-cell fraction as the chip summary states them

segments.description: one entry per segment: chromosome (the file's own name, X not 24), start and end (the file's coordinates), markers, estimated, major and minor (null where not estimated), raw_a and raw_b (the producer's raw nA/nB, null where empty), total_cn (the producer's total, fractional where it made no integer call), state (not-estimated, homozygous-deletion, loh, balanced, imbalanced) and relative_to_ploidy (below, equal, above, for LOH only, null when no ploidy is stated)

summary.description: how many segments carry a split, how many are LOH (and copy-neutral), homozygous deletions, imbalanced and balanced, and the autosomal LOH fraction
